chapter: First bands, illness and Houston life
title: Black history month in Houston schools; Barbara Jordan
summary: Cobb takes part in school clinics each February and mentions fellow Phillis Wheatley graduate Barbara Jordan.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Every February in Houston, Texas, I guess it's Texas wide, but we know it here, through the HISD, which is the Houston Independent School District, is black history month; the whole month of February, every year.

Well, I participate in this and I go from school to school, I do clinics, I give them the history of what I know from my knowledge and experiences and what have you. And it's quite an interesting thing. And, not only in my profession; people in other professions have come out of the schools here in Texas, and they recognize them.
Like, Barbara Jordan was in -- Phyllis Wheatley she's a graduate like me, but in later years. She's younger than me.

Barbara Jordan. And we've been on things together, in February, in Houston, as Phyllis Wheatley alumni. Mine was earlier -- in the 30's, but hers come later. But she's still an alumni OF PHYLLIS WHEATLEY. That's our alma mater, and this is the situation.
